answer.reason: The verses tell of Gaal's revolt against Abimelech and his expulsion from Shechem, which go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: spoke against Abimelech and urged the men of Shechem not to serve him
clauses.quote: Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him?

clauses.english: fought Abimelech and fled before him
clauses.quote: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.

clauses.english: was thrust out of Shechem by Zebul with his brethren
clauses.quote: Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.

doubts: The summary already says Gaal came to Shechem and was trusted there, so his arrival is left out.
The cited quote in the first clause is from JDG 9:28 only, though the clause also rests on 9:29.
